identity.label: NOT A242. In-repo proxy is wallstreet_ls.strategy.calculate_targets long/short.

price_meta.source: Yahoo Finance chart API v8, interval=1d, includeAdjustedClose=true

data.not_tested_through: 2026-11-08 is a Sunday. The Nov 7-9 weekend has no Monday open in the data. The final Friday is marked, not flattened.
data.adjustment: Signals use point-in-time rescaled adjusted closes (last row = raw close). Marks and gap P&L use one adjusted open/close factor, adj_open = raw_open * adj_close/raw_close, so dividends and splits hit open and close consistently.

dividend_example.note: Adjusted return puts the dividend back into the ex-date move. Raw close-to-close omits the cash dividend.

short_cap.rule: calculate_targets skips a short when the tradeable price exceeds starting_capital * max_position_weight ($220 at defaults).

execution_assumptions.hold: Month-end signal from calculate_targets trades at that session's close. Shares then stay fixed until the next month-end. Close-to-next-open gaps, including weekends and holidays, are marked.
execution_assumptions.flat: On the last session of each week, sell the book at that close and buy the same target weights at the next session's open, sized off equity at the open. A month-end that is also the week's last session defers the new book to the next open instead of trading twice.
execution_assumptions.slippage: 0, 5, and 10 bps PER SIDE versus the official open or close print. No NBBO, no intraday path, so trading a few minutes early is not separately identified.
execution_assumptions.regulatory: Primary grid charges none. The disclosed schedule is a separate 5 bps run. Alpaca equity commission modeled as zero. No penny rounding. CAT fee omitted.
execution_assumptions.cash_interest: Zero. Flat cash earns no T-bill interest. This leaves out a benefit of flattening a net-long book.
execution_assumptions.borrow: Zero. Holding shorts over the weekend is not charged borrow. This favors the hold policy if borrow is positive.
execution_assumptions.shorts: Fractional economically via adjusted units, but the share count is an integer number of tradeable shares, matching the live short rounder.
execution_assumptions.sizing: Long/short uses the live cap min(equity, $2,200). SPY and the four-name snapshot compound on full equity.

slices_predeclared.full: first invested close through last session
slices_predeclared.note: No weekday parameter was chosen from these windows.
